description: Sealed confirmation v2, release decision 1: auto (B) against chunk (A) at gbrain d44296c, judged answer correctness over all 200 questions, paired by question and clustered by persona (haystack). Rule: decision.json in this directory.

comparisons.description: Primary. auto must not be worse than chunk by more than 3 percentage points of the 200 questions.

Read by the preregistered superiority rule (decideEvidence) after non-inferiority passes: delta > 0, exact McNemar and persona-clustered sign-flip two-sided p < 0.05. compare.ts reports it without a verdict.
Shared retrieval over the 160 answerable questions; must be identical across arms (abstention rows have no recall and are ineligible on both sides).
